observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check before removing the frame-ancestors directive from CSP parts, and removes it only when the request path is an embeddable document.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent false-positive frame-ancestors reports for embedded documents, potentially reducing noise in CSP reporting while retaining protection for app pages.

observations.behavior: Updates a test assertion to expect that frame-ancestors is NOT present in the Report-Only header for an embedded document, rather than its presence.
observations.posthog_connection: This supports the implementation change by asserting the new expected behavior for embedded documents.
